extraction.Name: Jennie Wright
extraction.Refused/Protested: Yes it was my general talk about it that I was not capable of having a patent as I can not read. However, I did not tell the Harmer or Government employees this. I did not know enough to accept a patent and do not know what a patent is.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: we had to seal it on account of taxes and so forth
extraction.NOTES: Allottee states she never saw the patent and does not remember signing a receipt; records show she signed a receipt by thumb mark before Mr. Gruber and Frank McCloskey; husband James Wright also gave a statement and handled financial details of sale; allottee states she and husband intended to live there all their lives but patent was forced upon them; notarized May 7, 1929 by Jas.
